scholarships.title: University of Eastern Finland Early Bird Discount (30%) and Tuition Waivers

existing.description: The University of Eastern Finland offers tuition-fee-paying students from outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland an Early Bird discount of 30% on the first academic year's tuition, together with tuition waivers of 30% in the second and subsequent study years based on academic progress, plus Finnish Proficiency Tuition Waivers. UEF states its discounts and waivers generally cover up to 30% of tuition, that applicants cannot apply for full (100%) waivers, and that no humanitarian scholarships are offered. Tuition fees range from EUR 10,000 to EUR 12,000 per academic year.
eligibility: Student from outside the EU/EEA area or Switzerland
Applying to a UEF international bachelor's or master's degree programme for the 2027 intake
For the Early Bird discount: accept the admission offer and pay the tuition fee (or first instalment) by the deadline in the admission letter
For later-year waivers: continued enrolment and academic progress
existing.eligibility_summary: Tuition-fee-paying students from outside the EU/EEA area and Switzerland applying to UEF's international bachelor's and master's degree programmes for the 2027 intake. UEF states applicants cannot apply for full (100%) tuition waivers.
benefits: 30% Early Bird discount on the first academic year's tuition
30% tuition waiver in the second and third study years based on academic progress
Possible discretionary faculty merit scholarships for outstanding academic achievement
coverage: Early Bird discount of 30% of the first-year tuition fee
Tuition waiver of 30% of the annual tuition fee in the second and subsequent study years, based on academic progress
Finnish Proficiency Tuition Waivers rewarding achievements in Finnish language studies
requirements: Tuition fees are not required if the applicant meets one of the following conditions:
application_method: Apply to the programme through the normal Finnish admission process
Accept the admission offer and pay the tuition fee through Flywire by the deadline in the admission letter to obtain the Early Bird discount
Pay subsequent annual tuition fees by 31 August
existing.selection_notes: Once the student receives a decision on temporary protection, they must submit it to UEF as soon as possible.
existing.best_fit: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss applicants to UEF English-taught programmes who can pay promptly and keep up academic progress.
existing.notes: "UEF's tuition waiver programme is designed to provide partial support towards tuition fees. Applicants cannot apply for full (100%) tuition waivers. UEF also does not offer scholarships on humanitarian grounds." Applicants from outside the EU, EEA or Switzerland must pay a non-waivable application fee (Erasmus Mundus programmes excepted).
existing.duration: Early Bird discount covers the first academic year; tuition waivers apply to the second and subsequent study years
existing.application_period: 2027 intake; the Early Bird discount is triggered by accepting the admission offer and paying by the deadline in the admission letter
existing.deadline_display: "To qualify for the Early Bird discount, students must accept their offer of admission and pay the tuition fee, or the first instalment of the tuition fee, by the deadline stated in the admission letter (usually 21 days of the publication of the admission results). If the fee is paid in two equal instalments, the second instalment must be paid by 31 August." Subsequent years: "The annual tuition fee must be paid by 31 August".
existing.program_type: Early Bird tuition discount and academic-progress tuition waiver
